game: Resident Evil Mercenaries Vs. (2011) / BIOHAZARD VS. (2013)
target: Spoiler-free completion of preserved offline and local content, with discontinued service requirements identified honestly

areas.name: Archival Route and Service Check
areas.location_cue: The preserved application title screen and its mode-selection menu.
areas.note: The chosen GREE route and original matchmaking are discontinued; offline preservation remains usable where a lawful copy survives.

levels.1: The catalog selects the expanded later version first.
levels.2: Attempt to launch the preserved 2013 GREE iOS release on compatible legacy hardware.
levels.3: Confirm the application itself opens, then test authentication without purchasing or bypassing service checks. The official backend is discontinued, so record any menu reached and treat server-dependent content as externally unavailable.

levels.1: The earlier standalone build retains documented offline modes.
levels.2: Launch a lawfully preserved 2011 Mercenaries Vs. iOS installation.
levels.3: Use a compatible iPhone, iPod touch, or iPad, keep an archival backup, open Training and Coin Shooter, and confirm the three maps and three loadouts appear before tracking clears.

levels.1: Two nearby devices can preserve part of the multiplayer checklist.
levels.2: Pair two compatible devices running the same original application build.
levels.3: Enable Bluetooth on both devices, open the local battle lobby, join from the second copy, start a short match with two computer participants, and verify both devices reach results.

areas.name: Original iOS, Dock
areas.location_cue: A waterfront arena with cargo edges, narrow lanes, and open firing lines.
areas.note: Complete both solo modes and a local win with every fixed character loadout.

levels.1: Learn the route while building a continuous elimination chain.
levels.2: Finish a complete Training match on Dock with Chris.
levels.3: Select Chris and Dock, collect nearby time extensions before committing to a long fight, link eliminations without letting the chain expire, survive until the timer closes, and reach the saved results screen.

levels.1: This solo variant rewards deliberate collection while under pressure.
levels.2: Finish a complete Coin Shooter match on Dock with Chris.
levels.3: Select Chris and Dock, prioritize coin-producing targets and safe pickups, use the character's fixed weapon configuration to preserve the chain, and remain active until the mode posts its final total.

levels.1: A second preserved device keeps local competition available.

areas.name: Completion Audit
areas.location_cue: The original map, character, solo-mode, and Bluetooth result menus.
areas.note: Separate achievable archival clears from permanently service-bound historical content.

levels.1: Every map and loadout should have both solo results.
levels.2: Confirm Training and Coin Shooter results for all three characters across all three maps.
levels.3: Check the nine character-map pairings in each solo mode, giving eighteen completed results. Replay any pairing that lacks a full timed result rather than counting a menu preview or interrupted session.

levels.1: Local preservation adds one result per character and arena.
levels.2: Confirm a Bluetooth win with all three characters on Dock, Fort, and Castle.
levels.3: Review the nine character-map combinations, keep the winning results or your external archival log, and replay every combination not completed by the intended local player.

levels.1: A truthful checklist distinguishes shutdown content from unfinished play.
levels.2: Record the six original online entries and four GREE systems as unavailable unless a lawful working service is verified.
levels.3: Do not fabricate results or purchase access from unofficial sellers. Preserve menus and owned saves, document the backend failure, and leave each `NEEDS_VERIFICATION` entry open for future first-party restoration or authenticated archival evidence.
